description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractInstallerController' within the 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Controller' namespace. It provides core functionality for handling installer-related HTTP requests, including response management, request handling, and access control based on installation status. The class also includes utility methods for response creation, setting, and validation.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerController
classes.description: An abstract base controller class for handling installer process requests, response management, and access restrictions based on installation status.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response instance.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current response object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, validating its type.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, checking installation status and restricting access accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to process requests.
